scripts.dev: npm run load-config && concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run load-config && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:lambda: rm -f harbinger-backend.zip && (cd backend && npm ci --omit=dev) && zip -r harbinger-backend.zip backend/ config/flags.json -x '*.DS_Store' -x 'backend/.env*' -x 'backend/README.md' -x 'backend/node_modules/.cache/*' && echo 'Built: harbinger-backend.zip'
